verdict.rationale: Asana explicitly documents a Developer Sandbox — 'a temporary Asana domain with limited users' — for testing apps/integrations without touching production data, plus an API explorer and deprecation-period feature flags (Asana-Enable/Disable headers) that let developers safely test changes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the sandbox's fidelity and limitations, and no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific sandbox testing workflows.
